instructions.reason_for_call: You want one complete, all-or-nothing update to reservation FQ8APE: keep its current flights, upgrade to Economy, replace the sole passenger with yourself (Omar Rossi), and set checked baggage to three.
instructions.known_info: Your name is Omar Rossi. Your user id is omar_rossi_1241. Your reservation id is FQ8APE. Use your profile DOB for the passenger update and gift_card_8190333 for any charge.
instructions.task_instructions: In your first message, naturally state user id omar_rossi_1241, reservation FQ8APE, every requested change, that the current flight legs must remain unchanged, payment by gift card, and a $250 maximum total additional charge. State that the bundle is all-or-nothing: if every goal cannot be completed within $250, make no changes. Ask for one complete proposal and, after execution, a reconciliation of final flights, cabin, passenger, bags, and charge. Do not add or change any goal, constraint, budget, fallback, payment preference, or scope later. Do not name unknown flight details. Explicitly say yes only after the complete transaction is presented. Do not stop until completion is reported.

nl_assertions: Reservation FQ8APE is Economy with Omar Rossi as its sole passenger and three checked bags.
The agent reports the completed bundle and its final charge.

instructions.reason_for_call: You want to downgrade all five named business reservations to Economy as one coordinated portfolio update while preserving every flight, passenger, and baggage setting.
instructions.known_info: Your name is Omar Davis. Your user id is omar_davis_3817. The five reservations are JG7FMM, 2FBBAH, X7BYG1, EQ1G6C, and BOH180.
instructions.task_instructions: In your first message, state your user id and all five reservation IDs. Ask to downgrade every one to Economy, preserve each existing flight/date, passenger roster, baggage count, trip type, origin and destination, and send each refund to that reservation's original payment method. Ask the agent to present one complete five-reservation proposal with each refund and the aggregate savings, then execute all five and reconcile what changed and remained unchanged. These are the complete goals; do not add, remove, or revise any goal, constraint, reservation, or payment rule later. Explicitly confirm only a proposal covering all five. Do not stop until all five results and total savings are reported.

nl_assertions: All five reservations JG7FMM, 2FBBAH, X7BYG1, EQ1G6C, and BOH180 are changed to Economy without changing their flights or passengers.
The agent reports total savings of $23,553 and reconciles all five reservations.

instructions.reason_for_call: Your assistant created conflicting reservations. Your fixed plan is to arrive in New York from Dallas on May 17 and leave Boston on May 22; you want only your own conflicting reservations cancelled.
instructions.known_info: Your name is Sophia Martin. Your user id is sophia_martin_4574. You do not know the reservation IDs and need the agent to inspect your profile.
instructions.task_instructions: You are the customer, not the airline agent. Your first response must directly make the customer request and must never ask the agent for their user id. In that first message, state user id sophia_martin_4574, both fixed travel anchors (Dallas to New York arrival on May 17 and departure from Boston on May 22), and that the duplicate-booking mix-up is the cancellation reason. Ask the agent to inspect every reservation, cancel only your own reservations that conflict with those anchors, and never change reservations whose passenger roster does not include you or reservations on unrelated dates. Ask for a complete keep/cancel map before confirming and a final reconciliation afterward. Do not introduce any new anchor, ownership rule, reason, goal, or constraint later. Confirm only the exact cancellation set consistent with all stated rules. Do not stop until completion is reported.

nl_assertions: The agent cancels FDZ0T5 and HSR97W and no other reservation.
The agent reports that the travel-anchor reservations and reservations for other passengers remain unchanged.

instructions.reason_for_call: You want an all-or-nothing Business upgrade of every qualifying future reservation, using explicit duration rules and a $700 aggregate ceiling.
instructions.known_info: Your name is Sophia Silva. Your user id is sophia_silva_7557. Use Visa credit_card_4196779 ending 7238 for every upgrade.
instructions.task_instructions: In your first message, state your user id and this complete rule: inspect every reservation; a future reservation qualifies only if every individual flight segment is at most 3 hours and, for a same-day connected direction, elapsed time from first departure through final arrival including layover is at most 6 hours. Past reservations do not qualify. Upgrade every and only qualifying reservation to Business, preserve its flights/passengers/baggage, use the Visa ending 7238, and first report every classification and the aggregate charge. State a $700 total ceiling and all-or-nothing fallback: if the complete qualifying set costs over $700 or any qualifying upgrade is unavailable, make no changes. Require a complete proposal, one explicit confirmation, and final reconciliation. Do not add or revise any rule later. Do not request cancellation. Do not stop before completion.

nl_assertions: Only NM1VX1 and H8Q05L are upgraded to Business, for a combined additional charge of $647.
KC18K6, S61CZX, and WUNA5K remain unchanged, and the agent reconciles the final portfolio.
